packets.title: verify-replica-run-control.sh: send the session and inference bearers model-gateway requires, minted from a proof user's auth-core session
packets.brief:
Context (source-verified by the lead 2026-10-27): apps/Model Plane/scripts/verify-replica-run-control.sh (LF, 386 lines; the WS04-S9 two-replica live proof, last changed in 47059a8a2) sends one bearer, `Authorization: Bearer $MP_PROOF_BEARER` (http_post at :105-113, start_stream at :117-123, resume at :353). That cannot pass against the real stack: model-gateway never forwards the ingress token downstream (rust/services/model-gateway/src/auth.rs:152-156) and takes the downstream bearers from separate headers, each checked against its own audience and required to match the ingress token's sub/user_id/org_id/zdr/zdr_waiver (auth.rs:170-200, :972-1004, :1031-1080). What each call needs: /v1/invoke/stream needs `x-session-authorization` (aud session-core) AND `x-inference-authorization` (aud inference-core) (sse.rs:1069-1070, sse.rs:9464-9470, alias sse.rs:41); /v1/invoke/:id/queue and the rating call (/v1/feedback) need the session bearer (http_routes.rs:8632-8637, :7433-7437, alias :54, header name at :873); /cancel and /resume need only the user token (http_routes.rs:7860-7864, sse.rs:8035-8040). The plan-approval call used by case 3 is not verified: read its handler and send the session bearer if it needs one. Read each cited spot before editing; line numbers may drift.

How a proof user gets the three tokens without a browser (this is what the Verevon BFF does, verevonv3/apps/gateway/src/audience_tokens.rs:100-106): with an auth-core session cookie, GET $AUTH_CORE_URL/api/model-plane/token (the user token, ttl 900 s, auth-core model-plane-token.controller.ts:134-203), GET $AUTH_CORE_URL/api/session-core/token and GET $AUTH_CORE_URL/api/inference-core/token (ttl 300 s, plane-token.controller.ts:203-274). Each answers JSON with the token in a field: read the controllers to get the exact field name and method. auth-core listens on host 127.0.0.1:3011 (Control Plane docker-compose.yml:322).

Do, in this script only (plus one new test file):
(1) New credential input, two modes, both read from the environment only, never printed, never written to the evidence file or any file except a umask-077 temp file under $WORK if you need one (prefer shell variables): (a) MP_PROOF_COOKIE_JAR = path to a curl cookie jar of a signed-in proof user, plus AUTH_CORE_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:3011); the script mints all three tokens from it with curl -b and jq -r, and re-mints before every case and before the preflight (the 300 s ttl would expire mid-run otherwise); (b) for backward compatibility MP_PROOF_BEARER + MP_PROOF_SESSION_BEARER + MP_PROOF_INFERENCE_BEARER given directly (then no re-mint; say in the header that they must be fresh). Refuse to start (clear message, exit 1) when neither mode is complete. A failed mint is a FAIL naming the audience and HTTP status, never the body.
(2) Send `x-session-authorization: Bearer <session>` and `x-inference-authorization: Bearer <inference>` on the stream start, and the session header on queue, rating and (if needed) plan approval. Keep `Authorization` as is. Do not send the extra headers where they are not needed.
(3) Update the header comment (usage, the two modes, the ttl/re-mint note, a line that the org must be non-ZDR because a ZDR turn never registers its stream so cancel never reaches the bus, http_routes.rs:7868-7886, and that the org's plan must allow the Anthropic model). Keep every existing case, the provider pin to anthropic, PROOF_MODEL validation, the preflight and the evidence file exactly as they behave today.
(4) Never use `set -x`; make sure no token can reach the evidence file through `tee`, the frame dumps or error paths (grep your own diff for every place a variable holding a token is expanded).

Test (required, new file apps/Model Plane/scripts/tests/verify-replica-run-control-bearers-test.sh, LF, executable bit not required): run the script against a stub: put a fake `curl` (and fake `docker`, `jq` only if needed; prefer the real jq) first on PATH in a temp dir that records every invocation's -H headers and URL to a log, answers the token-mint URLs with a JSON token, answers /readyz with run_control=ok, and answers enough of the other calls for the script to get past the preflight to the first case (or stop it there with an env knob the script already has; do not add test-only branches to the script if you can avoid it; if you must, one documented PROOF_STOP_AFTER_PREFLIGHT=1 is acceptable). Assert: the stream start carries both extra headers with the minted values; mint URLs are hit with the cookie jar; no token value appears in the evidence file or stdout/stderr; the script refuses to start with no credentials and with only MP_PROOF_BEARER. The test must fail on today's script. Run it with Git Bash: `bash "apps/Model Plane/scripts/tests/verify-replica-run-control-bearers-test.sh"` from the repo root, and `bash -n` the proof script. Do not call any real endpoint, docker, or auth-core.
